id: \rYou again? I hate to admit it, but this operation has become a failure. Matori Matrix, retreat!
en: \rYou again? I hate to admit it, but this operation has become a failure. Matori Matrix, retreat!
it: \rAncora tu? Odio ammetterlo, ma questa operazione si è rivelata un fallimento. Matori Matrix, ritirata!

id: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:
en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:
it: Smart Rotom: chiamata in arrivo da Goh:

id: \bGoh: \PN, I found the mysterious Pokémon right before Team Rocket arrived. It was a Magikarp.
en: \bGoh: \PN, I found the mysterious Pokémon right before Team Rocket arrived. It was a Magikarp.
it: \bGoh: \PN, ho trovato il Pokémon misterioso poco prima che arrivasse il Team Rocket. Era un Magikarp.

id: \bI caught it and took it back to the lab. I'll be waiting for you there.
en: \bI caught it and took it back to the lab. I'll be waiting for you there.
it: \bL'ho catturato e l'ho portato al laboratorio. Ti aspetto lì.

id: \bI grow berries here in my spare time. They're my pride and joy.
en: \bI grow berries here in my spare time. They're my pride and joy.
it: \bNel tempo libero coltivo bacche qui. Sono il mio orgoglio e la mia gioia.

id: \rOh, he isn't special. But he's mine.
en: \rOh, he isn't special. But he's mine.
it: \rOh, lui non è speciale. Però è mio.

id: \rYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \rYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
it: \rSembri stanco. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \rOh, not in here. You should take a rest in the mansion. It has lovely accommodations.
en: \rOh, not in here. You should take a rest in the mansion. It has lovely accommodations.
it: \rOh, non qui. Dovresti riposarti nella villa. Ha delle sistemazioni deliziose.
